scientific_integrity: General equivalence follows by a new combination of contraction, centered Gaussian-mixture rigidity, nonorthogonality-graph spectral geometry and a conditional-variance kurtosis identity. Exact rational checks supplement but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Assumes iid positive-probability row choices, unit spanning rows, independent freshly resampled centered Gaussian measurement noise, and unit-relaxation projections. Fixed (once-drawn) measurement errors, correlated choices and non-Gaussian noises are outside scope. Novelty remains subject to specialist publication review.
title: Gaussianity is exactly a nonorthogonality-graph compatibility condition for noisy randomized Kaczmarz
